**Mod Name’s: Nuclear Winter**  
**Starting Point: Game start 7 days till stage 1 :**  
**Stage 1: Surface Degrades : Fallout Shelter, increased spawn rates, Player has Food poisoning at all times.**  
**Stage 2: Radiation \- Air is toxic player takes damage \-starts spreading wastelands**  
**Stage 3: Radiation \- Radiation Storms player takes increased damage and scar’s landscapes in a different way that wastelands**  
**Stage 4: Radiation \- Critical Protections no longer work effectively : IE Rad Suit : Radiation Purging mechanics top 20 blocks no longer habitable in anyway**  
**Stage 4.5: Reclamation Stage : De-Irradiate isolated zones First underground / followed by above ground**  
**Stage 5: Reclamation Stage 2 : De-Irradiate the world / Machine above the clouds**  
**Core Mechanics**

1. Radiation  
2. Staging to ramp up total possible radiation  
3. Blocks Changed to “Wasteland”   
4. Use of Equipment to Check for radiation and protect against it :   
5. Radiation storms, can be detected in advance by equipment.

**Extra Mods \-**   
**Radiation Mechanics**  
	Radiation mechanics will work on a multiple levels both from the sky and by certain blocks(ie, fallout). The main mechanic will be from the sky that is meant to make the surface hazardous. This radiation WILL NOT be detectable without equipment. A sufficiently irradiated person will no longer heal. Any radiation level above 66% will result in total item loss on death.

//Waste Spawns Toxic Sludge and Destablization  
// Advanced Nuclear Launch Silos

**Sky based Radiation**  
This will use a line straight down from the world height limit and calculate the radiation received by the player based on the amount and type of blocks overhead(air is ignored in these calculations). The maximum radiation that can be received will be based on one of 2 possible values from the config.  
	1\. The Normal maximum radiation level. This level is when there is no other source of radiation on the surface other than the sky. This is during no rad storm.  
	2\. The Total maximum radiation level. This is the the absolute maximum amount of radiation that can be from the sky(this is possible during a rad storm.)  
RadiationLeft \= CurrentRadiation\*0.5\*(1/BlockResistanceMod)

Resistance level based on 10 layers of stone. If you are under 10 layers of stone at least, you shouldn’t get any radiation poisoning(cumulative per tick)

**Staging Mechanics**  
	The Staging mechanics will be similar to that of Solar Apoc. The Stages will have a total maximum radiation level detailed below.

![][image2]

Stages(configurable duration, default 1 mc day)  
	**Stage 0:** This is like normal Minecraft basically in this stage the core mechanics are disabled.  
	**Stage 1:**  This is the start of the Radiation. It will slowly start to creep up till the end of stage 1\.   
	**Stage 2:** Radiation begins to dramatically ramp up. Rad raining increases significantly. Plants, and grass will no longer spread on the surface. Animals will no longer spawn on surface.  
	**Stage 3:** Radiation begins to become deadly. Nothing will grow, players outside for too long WILL die. Rad raining very high now.  
	**Stage 4:** Radiation is now at 100% of normal. Rad storms may start at the end of stage 4\. The beginning of stage 4 is when the chunk nuking routine will start working(basically it radiates an entire chunk at the time, to kill any surface shit off in mass).

**Block Changing Mechanic**  
	Every block in the game will be configurable to resist radiation as well as change when a certain threshold is reached. These are listed below  
	1: **Rad resistance**: This is a linear number that is subtracted from the total radiation that passes(would like to do logarithmic based, this can be changed later.)  
	2: **Degradation value**: This is the value at which the block will change to its configured degraded block. ie. If a stone block has a degradation value of 5000 and receives 6000 worth of rads and has a resistance of 1000\. The stone blocks received radiation will be 5000(as this is calculated AFTER the resistance is calculated.). This will result in the stone block changing to whatever is configured ie,Wasteland cracked stone. 

**Items protecting against radiation and checking for.**  
I need help here guys with some ideas. What I have below is some ideas.

**Radiation Badge:** Will change colors while in your possession as you receive radiation.. Black means dead man walking.  
**Geiger Counter:** Shows the amount of radiation in the area aimed at. Up to 1 chunk away.  
**Hazmat suit:** Can resist radiation for a certain amount of time, as it gets damage its resistance value drops. Surface use results in 3-5 minutes before you need to GTFO.  
**Lead(or iron or whatever) reinforced suit:** Much higher resistance to radiation. Degrades slower, but also makes you walk and cannot run.  
**Power Armor/Modular Powersuits:** Provides the most protection, rechargeable but VERY hard to get.
